title: First hire
summary: Offer out and signed, IP assigned, accounts provisioned, the first payroll run.

parts.title: Hire first employee
parts.guidance: Start with the approved role, worker location, budget and hiring authority. Use the first-employee workflow to coordinate the offer, employment paperwork and onboarding requirements for that specific hire. Pass the accepted terms, confirmed start arrangements and outstanding checks to the people setting up access and payroll.

parts.title: Get IP assignments signed
parts.guidance: Identify the work product, relevant existing agreements and any excluded prior intellectual property for this hire. Follow the IP-assignment workflow to obtain legal review and the appropriate parties' signatures. Store the completed agreement with access limited to the right owners, and record unresolved ownership questions before relying on the employee's work as company-owned material.

parts.title: Provision a workspace user
parts.guidance: Provision the confirmed hire's account from an approved access request, using the correct identity, start date, manager and necessary groups. Follow the user-creation workflow and test the intended sign-in path. Provide onboarding instructions through an approved channel, retain the granted access record, and ensure account creation does not silently authorize unrelated systems or elevated privileges.

parts.title: Run payroll
parts.guidance: Prepare the first payroll run using the accepted employment terms, confirmed start date, completed payroll records and approved time or adjustments. Reconcile the payroll preview and obtain release from the payroll approver. Retain the submitted run and payment results, resolving rejected payments or missing information before reporting the first pay cycle as complete.
